data.description: 开满温室花卉的罗德岛生态种植舱内，苏茜提着小喷壶弯下腰，温柔地给一盆盆盛开的金盏花浇水。几缕跳跃的微弱静电火花在她的指尖与花瓣间闪烁——「源石技艺带来的静电虽然偶尔会惹小麻烦……但用来刺激植物生长，花朵开得比平时更加鲜艳了呢。」
data.promptProse: Bending toward the marigolds, she tips the watering can toward their soil while faint static jumps between her free fingertips and a petal; greenhouse morning light shines through the leaves.
data.title: 澄闪 · 花房
data.animaCaption: She waters the marigold soil while faint static jumps from her free fingertips toward a petal.
